text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's the last of them carried over. 
...Thanks. For such a rare herb, you sure 
managed to gather quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Then, does that mean it's okay? To 
have that—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Unsanctioned race with me, please!!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
"That's it! They were selling tiara 
hairpins over there! Want me to buy one as 
a souvenir? It sparkles and shines!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To my dad, I'm still just a "kid" who gets 
overjoyed over a tiara hairpin!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But if I stay like that forever, I won't 
put him at ease. If I remain a child 
forever... That's why—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just like you showed your grandma, 
Sweep-san, I have to show him too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That I'm not just a kid who "admired" 
tiara horse girls... but a horse girl 
"worthy" of a tiara.

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
I don't just wanna "try" to become one...! 
I *will* become a great witch! Just you 
watch, Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! —Fine. Let's do this race!

One day, while taking a walk outside for a 
change of pace—

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me for bothering you so 
suddenly. Where might the training grounds 
be?

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
My daughter invited me to come watch her 
race. I got permission from the academy to 
visit, but...

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Let's see, where is 
Craft... Ah, there she is!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Next to her is... Huh?! Sweep Tosho?! 
Th-That's an incredible opponent...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, guess what! Next time you come home, 
I want you to come watch my race!

Under the clear blue sky, the gates opened 
for the two horse girls.
(*Thud, thud, thud, thud...!*)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(—Sweep-san drifted wide...! I have to 
seize this split second—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! What's the big deal about this 
much?! Who do you think you're dealing 
with!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: !! Kh... Sweep-san!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text: ! C-Craft...!!

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
No way! I wanna watch this race one more 
time! It's so cool! Just one more time!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
You said that and already watched it so 
many times, didn't you? My legs are 
starting to fall asleep here.

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
Because the *thud-thud-thud* is so 
amazing! I wonder if I can become like 
that too... like them...!

text_block_list.name: Craft & Sweep
text_block_list.text: TAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!! YAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I won't... loseeeeeeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Dad, are you watching?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've learned to run like this now. Running 
alongside friends, rivals, and the people 
I admire.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I won't sit on your lap anymore. After 
all, your legs would fall asleep, wouldn't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So... so from now on—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh~~~~!! I lost!!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You were just one step away. 
...Yeah. You were really... almost there.

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
—...Hey, Craft. You've really grown up, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—! ...Yeah! Next time, I definitely won't 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, whatever! Next time, I'm gonna beat 
you into the ground all over again!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! I'll work even harder so I 
won't lose!

The next day, I spotted Rhein Kraft and 
Sweep Tosho weeding together.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because there's another favor I want 
to ask Sweep-san for...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
She's being so annoying, begging me to run 
together next time. So I'm putting her to 
work!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—...Ehehe. I'll definitely find those 
herbs again!
